Write-once ToS stamp enforced by .is(platform_tos_accepted_at, null) on the UPDATE rather than a pre-read

Supabase Send-Email hook replacing default auth mail with tenant-branded Resend messages

Daily payment-reminder generation from unpaid ledger charges
Reminder cadence: two days out, due today, one day overdue, then weekly up to four weeks
Reminders are suppressed when the customer's open credit balance already covers the charge
Same-day dedupe on (charge, reminder_type) so a re-run cannot double-notify
only_rental_id scopes a manual Time Machine dispatch to one rental so it can never touch another tenant's charges
Operator dashboard KPI aggregation: overdue, due today, active rentals, open fines, revenue and fleet utilisation
Sixty-second in-memory cache keyed by date range, swept on each request
Promise.allSettled with per-query defaults so one failing KPI cannot blank the whole dashboard

Licence-plate region detection in vehicle photos via AWS Rekognition DetectText
Measured: zero plates found across eight real photos — 'nothing found' is the correct common answer and a false positive is worse
Conservative candidate filter: length bounds, a letter-and-digit requirement, and split confidence bars for exact vs shaped matches
Confusable glyphs are collapsed for MATCHING ONLY — the operator is always shown the raw detection
Cover the union of Rekognition's box and the measured quad, padding more when the quad says the text is skewed
Rebuild a plate OCR split across adjacent words, only when nothing already matched exactly
A read-only endpoint gated as tightly as a write, because every call costs real money at AWS
Tenant scoping is enforced explicitly rather than by RLS, so 'not yours' (403) can be told apart from 'does not exist' (404)
Prefer original_url — re-detecting on an already-masked copy finds nothing
A Rekognition failure returns 502, never found:false, so users are not trained to trust an answer that was never computed
